evidence.description: REQ-004 VERIFIED: FORBIDDEN_CAP_KEYS=["SOL_TRADE_MAX_SPEND"] is disjoint from REQ-001's 5 knob names; stripped defensively at every read/mutate path -- correctly mirrors genome.mjs:61-70's FORBIDDEN_CAP_KEYS/stripForbidden pattern.
REQ-013's field-name correction (sig/confirmed, not tx/status) INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED against record-swap.mjs's actual JSON payload -- correct and not assumed.

REQ-014 VERIFIED: evaluatePromotion() exists verbatim in evolve.mjs and is genuinely rail-agnostic (operates only on a genome_id->summary Map + baselineId/mutantId/minRedeems, no PM-specific field names in its body) -- REQ-014's 'import unchanged, do not reimplement' mandate is technically sound and enforced by PROP-014's import-identity test.

REQ-017's hard-override choke point pattern VERIFIED against PM's actual precedent: export MAX_BET_SIZE=2 etc. is genuinely unconditional (no ${VAR:-default} soft form), positioned immediately after genome eval -- REQ-017 correctly specifies hardening SOL_TRADE_MAX_SPEND into the identical unconditional form.

See FIND-001/FIND-002: the genome-attribution join algorithm and the realized-P&L summation field are both left unspecified in the behavioral spec (only implied in verification-architecture.md's Purity Map), a real requirement gap on the money-critical promotion path.

See FIND-003: unexplained asymmetry -- REQ-014 mandates literal reuse of evaluatePromotion with an import-identity test; REQ-015 does not extend the same mandate to the equally-reusable, equally-precedented promote() function.

Tier assignment VERIFIED sound: the 7 money-safety-critical surfaces (PROP-002/004/008/009/013/016/017) are correctly placed at Tier 2 (fast-check property-based testing over adversarial inputs) rather than under-tested at Tier 1, and the stated rationale for each is specific to a real risk (mutation excursion, forbidden-cap smuggling, engage-decision correctness, dev-safety override, earnings-gate row-counting, cross-instance isolation, cap hard-override).

PROP-007/008/009 VERIFIED adequately falsifiable: each states a concrete, checkable property (never-throws, NaN/Infinity->false, unset-or-not-exactly-"1"->engage always false) that a wrong implementation would fail.

See FIND-001/FIND-002: PROP-012 tests existence+ordering of the genome-linked trace line only, never that it is actually JOINABLE; PROP-013 tests row-filtering membership only, never the summed realized_usdc VALUE. Both are exactly the 'test that would pass even if the money-critical logic is wrong' failure mode this review is required to hunt for.

See FIND-003: PROP-015 tests only the git-commit OUTCOME (one file touched), never that the implementation is the REUSED evolve.mjs promote() rather than a fresh reimplementation -- no import-identity test exists for this surface, unlike PROP-014.

moneySafetyRuling.capsOutsideGenomeAndHardOverridden: PASS -- REQ-001/004/017 independently verified: SOL_TRADE_MAX_SPEND is not a knob key, is structurally disjoint from and stripped from every genome object (REQ-004), and REQ-017 correctly specifies the identical unconditional-export choke-point pattern already proven in polymarket-trade/run.sh:89-91.
moneySafetyRuling.promotionCountsOnlyRealConfirmedSwaps: PARTIAL PASS -- the FILTER (sig/confirmed/source) is independently verified correct against record-swap.mjs's actual output, but the SUMMATION of realized P&L is unspecified and untested (FIND-002), so the promotion gate's correctness cannot be certified end-to-end.
moneySafetyRuling.externalTrueNeverSetOnSwapLines: PASS -- record-swap.mjs (existing, unchanged code) already never sets external:true on sol-trade lines; this feature does not touch that guarantee.
moneySafetyRuling.devSafetyDefaultPaperOnly: PASS -- REQ-009's EARS is airtight: engage is forced false whenever SOL_GATE_LIVE_ENABLE is not exactly "1", including every truthy-looking near-miss string, and PROP-009 is correctly Tier 2 fast-check.
moneySafetyRuling.noEvolvedCodeInMoneyPath: PASS -- REQ-018's decideEngagement is specified as fixed/reviewed code; only numeric knob VALUES flow through mutation; PROP-018's static source-contract test (no eval/new Function/dynamic import) is the correct verification tool for this claim.

identitySafetyRuling: PASS -- REQ-006/016's per-instance ANICCA_HOME-gated path derivation correctly mirrors genome.mjs's existing, already-production-proven instanceOverridePath() convention (not a reinvention), and REQ-016 correctly requires the new pre-gate run strictly AFTER sol-trade/run.sh's existing identity-match guard (independently verified live in sol-trade/run.sh:29-38 and covered by the existing hermetic test suite in sol-trade/tests/test_run.sh cases (b)/(c)/(d)) rather than reimplementing it. No cross-instance genome-load path exists in the spec as written.
harnessNotCookRuling: PASS -- REQ-008/010/018 together correctly preserve HARD #0: the engage-decision's SCORING FORMULA is fixed/reviewed source code (same accepted pattern as PM's pick.py threshold comparisons), only its four numeric thresholds are ever mutated/evolved (REQ-002), and REQ-010 explicitly forbids the pre-gate from ever passing a directive (buy/sell/side/size) into franklin-trading's own invocation -- franklin-trading's internal model-debate judgment is untouched.

openQuestionRulings.openQuestion1_defaultThresholds: RULED SAFE (non-blocking). The four invented numeric defaults (2.0% momentum, $1M liquidity, conviction 6/10, 300s staleness) are individually reasonable/conservative, and even if miscalibrated they cannot cause over-trading on their own: REQ-009's dev-safety default (SOL_GATE_LIVE_ENABLE unset => engage always false) means no live trade can occur from ANY threshold value without a separate explicit human-triggered enablement step. Recommend the implementation-phase note (verification-architecture.md:84-97) also record this reasoning so a future reviewer does not need to re-derive it.
openQuestionRulings.openQuestion2_jupiterDependency: RULED ADEQUATE (non-blocking) for money-safety. REQ-007's fail-closed design (bounded 8s timeout -> stale-cache fallback bounded by SOL_GATE_MAX_STALENESS_SEC -> skip, never a fabricated signal) degrades safely toward 'never trade' if the free endpoint disappears or rate-limits permanently -- this is the money-safe direction. Noted, non-blocking, operational gap: the spec defines no alerting/escalation for a PERSISTENT outage (the pre-gate would silently skip every pass indefinitely, observable only by manually reading sol-gate.trace.jsonl's decision:"skip"/reason:"no-signal" lines) -- acceptable for this feature's money-safety scope but worth a follow-up ops note.

provenanceRuling: PASS -- REQ-014's claim that evaluatePromotion() is reused verbatim from evolve.mjs is independently verified: the function exists at evolve.mjs:132-152, is genuinely pure/rail-agnostic (no PM-specific field names inside its body), and behavioral-spec.md correctly does not reimplement its logic.
evidence: Reviewed specs/behavioral-spec.md (REQ-001..018) and specs/verification-architecture.md (PROP-001..018 + Purity Map) in full against ground truth read directly from ~/anicca/skills/earn/lib/genome.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/earn/lib/evolve.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/earn/sol-trade/run.sh, ~/anicca/skills/earn/sol-trade/lib/record-swap.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/_shared/lib/ledger.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/earn/lib/record.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/earn/lib/resolve-identity.mjs, ~/anicca/skills/earn/polymarket-trade/run.sh, ~/anicca/skills/earn/sol-trade/tests/test_run.sh, and the design spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-10-franklin-sol-evolvable-edge-design.md. Money-safety cap isolation, dev-safety default, no-evolved-code, and identity fail-closed claims are all independently verified correct. Three critical/major spec-fidelity gaps found on the money-critical genome-attribution and promotion path (genome-id join algorithm, realized-P&L summation field, promote()-reuse mandate) -- each is a case where the proof table's own property tests would pass even if the underlying money-safety logic were implemented wrong, which is the specific adversarial failure mode this review is mandated to hunt for. No manifest.json existed at reviews/spec/iteration-1/input/ at review time; this review proceeded directly from the task's explicit file list per instruction.
